PRIVACY

Your information.
A clear purpose.

Updated 14 October 2026.

Project enquiries

The enquiry form prepares a draft in your email app. Entries are not submitted to or stored by this website. You must send the draft yourself. Your email provider processes the draft and sent message.

Emails sent to contactkumarsmishra@gmail.com are received by Kumar and processed by the relevant email providers. Information is used to respond and discuss the project; sending an enquiry does not subscribe you to marketing.

Your requests

Contact Kumar to ask about access, correction or deletion of enquiry information. Any retention arrangements will be confirmed for the configured submission service before launch.

Call bookings

Cal.com processes the booking details and selected time you enter in its embedded scheduler. The booking page uses Google Meet. Calendar connections, confirmation messages, and appointment records are managed through Cal.com and the connected providers, which may use their own cookies and privacy terms.

Concept interactions

Demonstration bags and consultation previews run in the current page only. They do not create orders, appointments, payments, or customer records.

Hosting and fonts

Hosting providers may process request information for delivery and security. Typography is loaded through Google Fonts, which receives browser requests. No analytics or advertising trackers are implemented by this site. Private hosting access controls may use essential authentication mechanisms.
